why: No earlier contest for this seat is among the past results held here.
g: Every contest by precinct, ward, city or township

The Missouri Secretary of State publishes results by county only and sells the precinct files ('To purchase precinct data files ... contact the Elections Division'); nothing is bought for this record.

Kansas City lies in four counties; only its Jackson County part has an election authority of its own, so the parts in Clay, Platte and Cass counties are counted with those counties and cannot be told apart.
